extName.message: FocusLine — ADHD Reading Line & Focus Mode

extDescription.message: A draggable reading line that dims everything else. Built for ADHD and dyslexia readers. Local-only, no account.

unsupportedPage.message: This page cannot be used with extensions.

unsupportedHint.message: Open a normal website (http / https) and try again.

reloadHint.message: Reload the page and try again.

hudDrag.message: Drag the handle, or press Alt + ↑ / ↓

hudFollow.message: Reading line on · following the cursor

hudPick.message: Click the element to hide · Esc to cancel

hudHidden.message: Hidden. Undo it from the FocusLine menu.

welcomeLead.message: A draggable reading line that dims everything else. Built for ADHD and dyslexia readers — no account, no tracking, nothing leaves your browser.

step1Body.message: Click the FocusLine icon, flip the switch, and the page dims around the line you are reading.

step2Title.message: Put the line where your eyes rest

step2Body.message: Drag the handle on the right, or press <kbd>Alt</kbd> + <kbd>↑</kbd> / <kbd>↓</kbd>. Add <kbd>Shift</kbd> to change the band height.

step3Body.message: Calm mode stops animations. You can also hide floating banners and sidebars with one click.

calloutBody.message: Every website remembers its own line height, dim level, and hidden elements.

privacyBody.message: FocusLine stores your settings in chrome.storage.local on this device. It never sends page content, browsing history, or settings anywhere, and it makes no network requests at all.

footerPin.message: Pin FocusLine to your toolbar for one-click access.

placeHint.message: Alt + click anywhere to place the line

pdfHint.message: Chrome's built-in viewer cannot be modified by extensions. Open the file in FocusLine Reader to get the reading line.

pdfEmptyHint.message: Drop a PDF anywhere on this page, or use “Open file…”.

pdfErrorTitle.message: This PDF could not be opened

pdfNeedPermission.message: FocusLine needs access to this site to read the PDF. Open it from the FocusLine popup so the extension can ask for permission.

hudSnap.message: Reading line on · snapping to text lines

pinHint.message: Alt + click pins the line · Alt + right-click releases it

scResize.message: Make the line taller or shorter

scPlace.message: Place the line on a line of text

scRebind.message: Change the toggle and lock keys in your browser's extension shortcuts page.

translationNote.message: Spotted a translation mistake? Let the developer know.
